identitySignals: Agenda names 'Korey Stringer Institute, University of Connecticut' in Storrs, CT; the institute's own contact page gives its address as 2095 Hillside Road U-1110, Storrs, CT 06269-1110
The institute's About page describes the innovATe program (AT Services in Secondary Schools), matching the agenda grant title 'Korey Stringer Institute - innovATe Program'
The institute is based in the University of Connecticut's Department of Kinesiology, matching 'University of Connecticut' in the agenda text
research.notes: A unit of the University of Connecticut (public university), so no separate nonprofit EIN or California entity number was listed. No general email is shown on the contact page, only a form. The agenda item is a grant application, not a purchase.

profile.summary: The Korey Stringer Institute is a research and outreach center at the University of Connecticut. It works to prevent sudden death in sport, military and labor settings through research, education, consultation, advocacy and athlete testing. Its innovATe program expands athletic trainer services in high schools.

sources.title: Contact the Institute - Korey Stringer Institute

review.notes: The About and Contact pages confirm the Korey Stringer Institute is a UConn research and outreach center in Storrs, CT that runs the innovATe secondary-school athletic training program, matching the agenda's grant application. Phone, address, website and the neutral summary are all supported by the cited pages.
